description: Source code for the ADODB MySQLi database driver class, implementing database connection, transaction management, SQL utilities, meta-information retrieval, and integration with MySQLi extension features.

classes.name: ADODB_mysqli
classes.description: Main class providing MySQLi-based database connection, transaction handling, SQL query execution, meta-information retrieval, and configuration management.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_mysqli
classes.description: Recordset class for handling result sets fetched via MySQLi extension, with methods for iterating over rows, fetching fields, and converting data formats.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the database session.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MySQL database using mysqli extension.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Creates a persistent database connection.

methods.name: _nconnect
methods.description: Forces a new connection to the database, closing existing ones if necessary.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server version information.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a new transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: qstr
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in SQL queries, considering PHP magic quotes settings.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Retrieves the last insert ID after an insert operation.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table for generating unique IDs.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new unique ID from a sequence.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all databases on the server.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specified table.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Constructs a SQL expression for date formatting based on provided format string.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Constructs a SQL expression for concatenating multiple fields or strings.

methods.name: OffsetDate
methods.description: Calculates a date offset by a fractional number of days.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Returns a list of database tables, with optional schema filtering.

methods.name: MetaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a given table.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects a database to use for subsequent queries.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement for execution.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query or prepared statement with bound parameters.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from MySQLi.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number from MySQLi.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: CharMax
methods.description: Returns maximum length for character columns.

methods.name: TextMax
methods.description: Returns maximum length for text/blob columns.

methods.name: GetCharSet
methods.description: Retrieves the current character set used by the connection.

methods.name: SetCharSet
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for the connection.
